headline: I'm Manoj. Currently working as business analyst in Germany
bio: I'm Manoj. Currently working as business analyst in Germany
building: I am currently obsessed with solving the post-visa "black hole" for international students moving to Germany. While getting a university admission and visa is a huge milestone, incoming students are left completely stranded when trying to find private housing from 6,000 miles away—exposing them to rampant rental scams and confusing German bureaucracy like city registration (Anmeldung). To fix this, I am building NextKin—a trusted hybrid onboarding platform that operates like "TurboTax meets TaskRabbit" for student relocation, combining automated paperwork with a 100% legal on-ground network of university graduates and student buddies.
